The left column runs to the foot and carries on into the right column. Printed page number at top right. A small mark "22." at the foot right of the right column.

main_text.p: pl. fæm. No. נָחַל R. נָחַל possedit.
וַנְּחַלְתָּנוּ[?] & possedisti nos, præc. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. Rad. נָחַל.
נָחַם consolari, Infin. Piel, Rad. נָחַם.
נָחַם consolatus est, נִחַם consolatus, præt. Niph. vel Piel, 3. f. m, & Part. Niph. sing. m. Rad. נָחַם.
נַחַם pœnitentiam, No. f. m. Rad. נָחַם consoleri[?].
נֻחַם desideratus fuit, vel נֶחְמָר desideratus, הִנָּחְמְרוּ desiderati, præt. Niph. 3. f. m. vel Part. Niph. f. m. ut & Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. חָמַד.
וַנְּחַמְּרוּ[?] & desiderabimus eum, fut. Kal 1. pl. aff. R. חָמַד.
נֶחְמָה[?] consolatione affecta, præt. vel Part. Puål, f. f. Rad. נָחַם.
נֻחַמוּ[?] consolati sunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. נֻחֲמוּ consolamini, Impef. Piel, pl. m. Rad. נָחַם.
הִנָּחְמִים incalescentes, Jef. 57. 5. pro נִחְמִים, Part. Niph. pl. m. Rad. חָמַם.
נִחְמִים, vel נֶחְמָּם consolationes, נָחַם pœnitentiæ meæ, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. נָחַם.
נִחְמְּסוּ violenter ablata sunt, præt. Niph. 3. pl. R. חָמַס.
נִחֲמָתִי consolatio meâ, sing. fæm. aff. No. נֶחְמָה, Rad. נָחַם.
נֻחַמְתִּים consolatus sum eos, præt. Piel, 1. sing. aff. Rad. נָחַם.
נַחְנוּ nos, pro אֲנַחְנוּ, Pronom. 1. pl. à f. m. Rad. אֲנִי ego.
נְחָנִי deduxit me, נְחָנִי deduc me, Præt. Kal, f. m. & Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. R. נָחָה.

page.notes: Hebrew letters are approximate: the scan is heavily speckled and the vowel points and some consonants are not legible letter by letter; the forms marked [?] are doubtful. The running head at the top (Hebrew letters above each column) is not clearly legible and is marked [?]. The foot mark "22." is taken as a signature and may instead be a catchword or part of a signature; it is doubtful. Abbreviations (Rad., Piel, Niph., etc.) are copied as printed. The line "gratiosa fuisti, Jer." is the last line on the page and is cut off at the foot by the scan edge; its continuation is not on this page.
